statusVocabulary.covered: generic repository-wide conformance foundation exists, evidence is active, and no domain blocker remains
statusVocabulary.partial: substantial executable evidence exists but generic foundation or enforcement is incomplete
statusVocabulary.missing: required generic foundation is absent or only historical evidence exists
statusVocabulary.blocked: a non-waivable conformance finding prevents readiness for the dependent milestone

strengths: Core canonical Stable Identity schema/kinds/format/assertion are active and backend independent.
New Project Nodes use NGVGE-owned canonical NodeIds rather than Scratch target.id.
Legacy target-derived ids are migration-only input with cross-project-section alias remapping.
Stable Runtime Node/Component persistence evidence remains protected by existing architecture gates.
gaps: Generic Identity Registry collision/ownership tracking is not yet repository-wide.
Repository-wide compile-time TypeScript branding is deferred to preserve the frozen R9 TypeScript scope.
Scratch Adapter BindingId conformance remains C001.1-G.
c0011ExitCriteria: Canonical backend-independent Stable Identity vocabulary exists and is executable.
New target-backed Project Nodes never derive NodeId from Scratch target.id.
Legacy target-derived records and NGVGE project-section references migrate transactionally before restore.
Stable Identity destructive/static regression evidence remains active.

strengths: Generic src/core Schema Registry now exists independently of Runtime Component implementation.
ngvge-schema-descriptor/v1 validates type/version/property/default/nullability/range/unit/resource/persistence/validation metadata.
Schema metadata/defaults are constrained by Core Persistent DTO authority.
Duplicate type/version registration fails closed; batch registration is atomic and query snapshots are immutable.
Runtime Component schema/version/migration semantics remain strong supporting evidence without owning the generic Core contract.
gaps: Schema Migration Graph/provider execution is deferred to C001.4 / ARC-0004.
Schema-aware validation of arbitrary persistent records is deferred to C001.2.
No gate yet requires every persistent semantic record to reference a registered versioned schema.
Final property type system and custom Inspector/Gizmo/Validator registration remain ARC-0004 work.
c0011ExitCriteria: Generic Core Schema Registry exists independently of Runtime Component implementation.
Version/type/default/persistence metadata can be registered and validated.
Unknown/duplicate/invalid schema registration fails closed.

strengths: Generic src/core State Domain Authority Registry now exists independently of Module Capability and compatibility implementations.
Writer / projection / observer roles are explicit and projection registrations carry explicit direction.
A second active writer for the same State Domain fails closed; batch registration is atomic on conflicts.
Authority registrations and Registry snapshots are immutable and deterministic.
Capability publication/generation/revocation remains strong Runtime/Module-specific supporting evidence.
gaps: Projection Loop Prevention and Mutation Context are deferred to C001.3 / ARC-0003.
Transactional Authority Switch is deferred to C001.3 / ARC-0003.
Transform2D Scratch Compatibility Authority is not wired until 0009.
Capability ownership has not yet been integrated as a consumer of the generic Core Authority model.
c0011ExitCriteria: Generic StateDomain Authority Registry exists.
A second active writer for the same domain is rejected.
Writer / projection / observer roles are explicit.
Capability authority remains a consumer of Core authority semantics rather than the generic model itself.

strengths: Exact portable Runtime Node API, sanitized errors, frozen snapshots and primitive Scene controller protocol exist.
Generic ngvge.engine-protocol v1 Command/Query/Event/ProtocolError DTO foundation is active.
Core protocol values reject runtime/native object representations and Query snapshots are detached/deep-frozen.
gaps: No repository-wide Editor mutation→Command rule.
No generic protocol version negotiation/pagination foundation.
No transaction/event-commit transport semantics.
c0011ExitCriteria: Generic Engine Command / Query / Event / ProtocolError DTO contracts exist.
Core protocol DTOs reject backend/native handles.
Query results are plain/frozen snapshots rather than internal mutable services.

strengths: Runtime Node/Component and module lifecycle/reentrancy/revocation plus Scene disable/re-enable are strongly tested.
C001.1-A establishes a backend-independent ownership zone in which future lifecycle contracts can live without Scratch/React/DOM dependencies.
gaps: No unified full lifecycle harness across all systems.
No generic leak accounting for Timer/Listener/Worker/DOM/Resource.
Device Lost/Restore and Hot Reload lifecycle are not generically gated.
c0011Work: C001.1-A Semantic Ownership Zone / Core Boundary
c0011ExitCriteria: Core lifecycle vocabulary/contracts can exist without Scratch/React/backend imports.
Existing lifecycle destructive corpus is mapped to stable C001 rule IDs.
Full leak accounting remains deferred to C001.4.
c0011CompletedWork: C001.1-A ownership boundary established; lifecycle vocabulary remains deferred.

Legacy persistence API delegates to Core so existing Runtime/Scene consumers share one semantic authority.
Project Persistence validates/clones section payloads through Core instead of JSON stringify/parse sanitization.
Runtime Node, Scene V2, SB3 and Project Node persistence remain protected by regression/integration evidence.
Core Schema descriptors now provide versioned metadata authority on top of the Persistent DTO substrate.
gaps: Schema-aware validation of arbitrary persistent records is deferred to C001.2.
Repository-wide compile-time PersistentDTO<T> branding is deferred under the frozen R9 TypeScript scope.
0008.8 remains historical evidence rather than current architecture entrypoint.
c0011ExitCriteria: Repository-level Persistent DTO validator foundation is active.
Persistent stable identity is backend-independent.
Existing plain-data rejection semantics are promoted without weakening fail-closed behavior.
Schema-aware PersistentDTO branding remains eligible for C001.2 extension.

strengths: C001.1-A establishes an active src/core import/ambient boundary gate with default-deny external dependencies.
Legacy target-derived Project Node ids are accepted only at compatibility migration boundaries; current Project Node writes are backend-independent.
C001.1-G promotes the Scratch Adapter boundary into an active/manual ARC-C001 gate independent of the historical task entrypoint.
Stable BindingId/NodeId persistence, runtime-only targetRuntimeId, target-free immutable binding views and semantic-owner tree projection are machine enforced.
gaps: No Scratch semantic trace/native comparison foundation.
c0011ExitCriteria: Core Import Boundary Gate prevents Core → Scratch/Backend/Editor leakage.
Scratch Adapter boundary is active C001 evidence, not historical-only.
Scratch target.id remains runtime-only and cannot define persistent semantic identity.
Compatibility objects terminate at adapter/host boundaries.
c0011CompletedWork: C001.1-A Semantic Ownership Zone / Import Boundary

c0011MinimumReadiness.note: C001.1-A active manual gate: src/core is dependency-closed, bare imports default-deny, non-literal loads and configured ambient backend/editor globals fail closed.
C001.1-C establishes ngvge-persistent-dto/v1 as Core structural persistence authority; legacy callers delegate to Core and Project Persistence fails closed before cloning.

C001.1-B establishes canonical backend-independent identity semantics in Core, Host-injected entropy, Project Node v4 ownership and transactional legacy alias migration while preserving R9 TypeScript scope.
C001.1-E establishes ngvge-authority-registration/v1, explicit writer/projection/observer roles, immutable snapshots and fail-closed single-writer-per-StateDomain enforcement.
C001.1-F establishes ngvge.engine-protocol v1 Command/Query/Event/ProtocolError DTOs, portable value rejection and detached/deep-frozen Query snapshots.

C001.1-D establishes generic append-only versioned Core Schema authority with Persistent DTO-constrained metadata, immutable snapshots, atomic batch registration and fail-closed duplicate/invalid registration.

C001.1-G promotes the historical 0008.7.3 corpus into an independent active/manual compatibility gate; targetRuntimeId remains runtime-only and compatibility representation terminates at the adapter boundary.
